description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Ident, which validates CSS identifier strings according to the {ident} CSS grammar production. It includes a validate method that checks if a string conforms to specific CSS identifier rules.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Ident
classes.description: A class for validating CSS identifier values in the context of HTML Purifier's attribute definition system.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates whether a given string matches the CSS ident production. Returns the string if valid, false otherwise.
